inputs.population: the oracle Stage A proposals with status ok (#43): their action and decoded previous slot

window.observations: [o'_{t-1}, o_t]: o'_{t-1} the agent position and T keypoints of the predecessor state P; o_t the source frame's own
window.actions: slot 0 the preceding action b; slot 1 the proposal action (the correction); slot k >= 2 the demonstrated action of frame t + k - 1, the episode's last action beyond its end
window.chain: P loaded fresh (oracle.json simulator fresh_state), then in the same live space: b, the correction, then the demonstrated actions
window.anchor: the source frame t; eligible when t <= T - 1 - drop_n_last_frames (LeRobot's rule) and frame t - 1 is a source row

solve.unknowns: z = (agent x, y, T x, y, l*theta, agent vx*dt, vy*dt, T vx*dt, vy*dt, l*omega*dt, b x, b y), px; dt = 0.1 s
solve.residual: (r(after b, frame t), r(after the correction, frame t + 1)), oracle.json's r, 10 values in px
solve.init: positions: the oracle's decoded previous slot; velocities: the replayed source state at t - 1; b: the demonstrated action of frame t - 1
solve.method: Gauss-Newton: the minimum-norm least-squares step (lstsq, singular values below rcond times the largest treated as zero). The residual is rank-deficient by design: when nothing touches the T, its velocity dies within one control step, so its position after b and after the correction are the same equation; those rows are consistent and the step ignores the redundancy
solve.jacobian: central finite differences of the residual in z
solve.singular: the Jacobian is non-finite or zero
solve.converged: distance(after b, frame t) <= tolerance_px and distance(after the correction, frame t + 1) <= tolerance_px

mask.rule: slots 0 and 1 are supervised; slot k >= 2 is supervised when its frame t + k - 1 lies in the episode and the chain's positions at frames t + 1 .. t + k - 1 are each within continuation_px of the recorded frames
mask.required: the executed chunk (slots 1 .. n_action_steps) is supervised

validity.action_bounds_apply_to: every supervised action slot: b, the correction and the supervised demonstrated actions
validity.action_change: ||b - a_{t-1}|| <= the 99.9th percentile of ||a_s - a_{s-1}|| over consecutive subset source rows
validity.speed: P's agent speed, T speed and l*|omega| each <= its maximum over the replay-verified subset source states
validity.envelope: oracle.json validity.envelope (penetration and extent), at P and at every chain state where a supervised action is applied

selection: one window per source anchor: of its accepted proposals in candidate-row order, the index default_rng(SeedSequence([52, source row])).integers(count)

yield.n_real: the subset's real Diffusion Policy windows (ilsb.temporal, the window above)
yield.pass: at least n_synthetic selected windows (distinct anchors) from at least min_episodes episodes

novelty: o'_{t-1} against the source frame t - 1 and the oracle's decoded previous slot (oracle_probe.distance), and the history's distance to the nearest real history of the subset
containment: every slot's episode is a subset episode of roles.train; by content, no window observation equals a held-out (roles.held_out) observation (current or previous slot). Actions are not compared: a 2-d target can coincide by chance
